configuration.experimental.modelProvider: Character limit for experimental model web requests, separate from the sidebar limit. Older complete exchanges may be omitted, but System instructions, all user requests, the latest tool exchange and tool definitions are preserved. The actual web input limit takes precedence.

Offer the experimental M365 Web model in the VS Code model picker. Sign in separately in its dedicated browser. VS Code tools follow host approval policy; sidebar hash/range validation and Undo do not apply.
configuration.copilotUrl.description: Your M365 Copilot or Code Assistant agent web URL.
configuration.browserChannel.description: Browser installed on this PC. No separate browser extension is required.
configuration.maxRounds.description: Safety limit for Copilot requests per task (default 100, maximum 500). Repeated unchanged reads, failures or command results stop earlier. Explicit user values are preserved. Unlimited requests disables only this count limit.
configuration.loginTimeoutSeconds.descri: Seconds to keep the first request queued while waiting for sign-in/MFA and input readiness. It is sent automatically once ready.
configuration.modelButtonSelector.descri: CSS selector for the web model menu button when automatic detection fails. Only account-visible models are offered.
configuration.maxPromptCharacters.descri: Maximum characters in a web request. Context is reduced before submission if the web input has a smaller limit.
configuration.maxFileSizeMB.description: Maximum size in MB of local text files to read or partially edit. Only necessary ranges are sent to the website.
configuration.commandOutputEncoding.desc: Command output encoding and Windows code page. Choose cp949 for tools that require it.
configuration.composerSelector.descripti: Copilot input CSS selector when automatic detection fails.
configuration.sendButtonSelector.descrip: Optional Send button CSS selector. When empty, the button and submission acknowledgement are detected automatically.
configuration.responseSelector.descripti: Optional CSS selector for the Copilot response container.
configuration.browserView.description: Copilot browser display location. editor shows the actual automated browser in a VS Code tab. Use external for native authentication windows.
configuration.attachmentMaxFileSizeMB.de: Maximum original attachment size in MB per image, document or video. Smaller Copilot web upload limits take precedence.
configuration.attachmentMaxTotalSizeMB.d: Maximum total size in MB of selected original attachments per request. Videos are sampled into three local scene images.
configuration.attachmentTimeoutSeconds.d: Seconds to wait for confirmed Copilot attachment upload readiness.
configuration.attachmentInputSelector.de: CSS selector for the Copilot local file input (input[type=file]) when automatic detection fails.
configuration.attachmentButtonSelector.d: CSS selector for the Copilot local attachment menu button when automatic detection fails.
configuration.attachmentReadySelector.de: CSS selector for uploaded filename cards inside the input area.
configuration.attachmentErrorSelector.de: CSS selector for upload error messages inside the input area.
configuration.attachmentScopeSelector.de: CSS selector for the composer area containing attachment cards and upload state. Exclude conversation history.
language.description: Display language for the sidebar, panels, notifications and activity. Automatic uses the OS locale reported by VS Code (Korean for ko, English otherwise), falling back to the platform locale. Changes apply immediately. Command and Settings labels follow the VS Code display language. Model answers follow your request.
